title: Rust Foundations
summary: Learn Rust after C: ownership, borrowing, structs, enums, error handling and collections, with memory safety checked by the compiler.
description: You know what a pointer is and how easily C lets you misuse one. Rust keeps the same low-level control but has the compiler prove your memory use is safe. You'll learn ownership and borrowing, strings, vectors and iterators, structs, enums and match, Result-based error handling and HashMaps.
outcomes: Use ownership, borrowing and error handling to write memory-safe Rust.
